info.name: Wild Atlas — API v1
info.description: Contract tests for Wild Atlas. Run folders in order 00 → 09. Every read asserts that no site coordinates leak. Import the local environment, start the app, seed the database, then Run collection.

exec: pm.test("each card has an access point", () => {

body.raw:
{
  "placeSlug": "{{slug}}",
  "field": "accessWindow",
  "message": "Gate was closed at 16:30 on 24 Nov 2026. The sign says 17:00.",
  "channel": "WEB",
  "website": ""
}

exec: pm.test("token is not in the deep link twice", () => pm.expect(b.deepLink).to.include(b.token));
pm.test("no id returned for a bot", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.be.undefined);
